`README.md` specifies the behaviour exactly: the token grammar (it is stricter than what `str::parse::<f64>` accepts), the operand order, `%` and `^`, the error cases and which error wins when there are several, and the `Display` messages, with worked examples. Follow it to the letter: more tests than the visible ones, covering the rest of the README, are run when your work is checked.

Use only the standard library (no crates; the build is offline). Do not edit anything under `tests/`. Check your work with `cargo test --offline --quiet`.
